verdict.rationale: The Claude Agent SDK is a wrapper/orchestration layer around the proprietary Claude models and requires the Claude CLI subprocess and Anthropic API/subscription access — it cannot be self-hosted independent of Anthropic's hosted model and account restrictions. Community evidence even shows Anthropic tightening restrictions on how the SDK can be used with subscriptions, reinforcing that this is a hosted-dependent product, not something one can self-host as a core product.
